# Task 1 {-}

$$L(p) = \prod_{i=1}^{3} \binom{n}{x_i} p^{x_i} (1-p)^{n-x_i}$$
$$L(p) = \binom{20}{9}p^9(1-p)^{11} \times \binom{20}{10}p^{10}(1-p)^{10} \times \binom{20}{11}p^{11}(1-p)^{9}$$
$$L(p) = \left[ \binom{20}{9} \binom{20}{10} \binom{20}{11} \right] p^{30}(1-p)^{30}$$


```{r}
# Define the binomial log-likelihood function
logbin <- function(x, param) log(dbinom(x, prob = param, size = 10))

# Set up the parameter grid for probability p
param_grid <- seq(0, 1, length = 1000)

# Call the maximum likelihood function 
mle_task1 <- mymaxlik(lfun = logbin, 
                      x = c(2), 
                      param = param_grid, 
                      xlab = expression(p), 
                      main = "Binomial MLE Grid Search")

# View the returned MLE summary/list
mle_task1
```


b. The first index covers where the max log likelihood value occurs. The next part of the function covers the MLE for p. The next part of the function covers p hat. The last part of the function covers the slope of the peak. 

c. The value of p hat that is likely to generate the observed data out of the total number of trials. 

```{r}
# call the function to find the roots
v <- mymaxlik(x=c(2),
         param=seq(0,1,length=1000),
         lfun=logbin,xlab=expression(pi),
         main="Binomial",
         cex.main=2)
```

# Task 2 {-}

a. The radioactive decay follows the poisson distribution
c. The list returns the MLE value at a particular parameter estimate. The log MLE value at a particular estimate and the slopes for each paramters estimate were also returned. 

```{r}
# Log-likelihood function for Poisson 
logpoiss <- function(x, param) log(dpois(x, lambda = param))

# Data vector
y <- c(5, 5, 6, 7)

# Grid of parameter values for lambda
param <- seq(0, 15, length = 1000)

# Function call
mymaxlik(x = y, param = param, lfun = logpoiss, xlab = expression(lambda), main = "Poisson")

# return list
output <- mymaxlik(lfun = logpoiss, x = y, param = param, xlab = expression(lambda), main = "Poisson")

# inspect the list
output

# access items in the list
output$parami
output$yi
output$slope
```

# Task 4 {-}


```{r}
# calculate log of probability functions 
logbin3 <- function(theta) {
  log(dbinom(4, prob = theta, size = 10)) + 
  log(dbinom(12, prob = theta, size = 20)) + 
  log(dbinom(7, prob = theta, size = 15))
}

# create sequence 
theta_grid <- seq(0, 1, length = 10000)
# call function 
mle_comp <- mymaxlikg(lfun = "logbin3", theta = theta_grid)
# display output 
mle_comp
```

# Task 5 {-}


b. The output returns the estimate for the mean which maximizes the joint likelihood, which closely matches the sample mean. The output also returns the estimate of the standard deviation which maximizes the joint likelihood and the peak joint likelihood value. 

```{r}
# create vector and number sequence 
x_norm <- c(5, 7, 7, 8, 10)
mu_grid <- seq(4, 11, length = 500)
sig_grid <- seq(0.5, 5, length = 500)

# call function 
norm_mle <- mymlnorm(x = x_norm, mu = mu_grid, sig = sig_grid)

# Estimated parameters
list(muest = norm_mle$muest, sigest = norm_mle$sigest, maxl = norm_mle$maxl)
```

# Task 6 {-}
mynew_improved changed the calculation of the derivative from the original function derivative calculation.  

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
myNRML(x0 = 0.99, delta = 0.00001, 
       llik = function(x) log(dbinom(12, size = 20, prob = x) * dbinom(10, size = 25, prob = x)), 
       xrange = c(0.01, 0.99), parameter = "p")
```

```{r}
g <- function(x) x^2 - 5*x + 6

# Root 1 starting at x0 = 1
root1 <- mynewt_improved(x0 = 1, delta = 0.00001, f = g, xlim = c(0, 5))
cat("Root 1 converged to:", root1$x[length(root1$x)], "\n")

# Root 2 starting at x0 = 4
root2 <- mynewt_improved(x0 = 4, delta = 0.00001, f = g, xlim = c(0, 5))
cat("Root 2 converged to:", root2$x[length(root2$x)], "\n")
```

# Task 7 {-}



```{r}
# set seed 
set.seed(39)
# create random sequence of numbers
sam_data <- rnorm(25, mean = 25, sd = 10)

# boostrap function 
boot_out <- myboot(iter = 10000, x = sam_data, fun = "mean", alpha = 0.05, 
                   xlab = "Sample Mean", col = "Purple")

# 95% Confidence Interval bounds
boot_out$ci
```
```{r}
# create CI and bootstrap for DDT dataset
weight_data <- DDT$WEIGHT  
# bootstrap function
boot_ddt <- myboot(iter = 10000, x = weight_data, fun = "mean", alpha = 0.05,
                   xlab = "LMBASS Weight", col = "Purple")
# create confidence interval
boot_ddt$ci

# t test conf int
t.test(weight_data)$conf.int
```
